0022600131.text: The Lakers, who are 2-0 at home and first in the Pacific and the West, host the Portland Trail Blazers, who are also 2-0 and fourth in the West, in a regular-season game that is the Lakers' fourth of the 2026-27 season. Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and has Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost the season series 1-2, including a 132-116 defeat in Portland on January 17.
